column1: # The public JSON-LD corpus: tools/corpus/fetch-jsonld.sh downloads it into
#   kind     doc: a JSON-LD document, parsed with its URL as the base;
#            context: a remote @context document, served offline for every
#            schemaorg-examples: a schema.org examples file, split into one
#   name     where it lands under test/corpus/jsonld/
#   url      where it comes from (raw files pinned to a commit where possible)
#   licence  SPDX identifier, or the licence's name
#   source   repository@commit, or the publisher for documents served by URL
#   serves   context rows only: the @context IRIs this file answers
# Remote @context documents the corpus needs, served offline by the oracle.
